stories.title: Mumbai property registrations rise 9% in October
stories.summary: Property registrations in the Mumbai municipal region rose 9% year on year in October to 12,690 units, Knight Frank said, citing state registration data. Stamp duty collections rose 12% to Rs 1,173 crore. Most registrations were homes, and the stamp office had a good month too.

stories.title: Foreign money into Indian real estate jumps 134% in Q3
stories.summary: Foreign investment in Indian real estate rose 134% year on year to $1.4 billion in July to September, Cushman and Wakefield said. Total institutional investment reached $2.1 billion, with foreign investors supplying 68%. Domestic institutional money fell 34% from the previous quarter.

stories.title: Private equity in Indian property falls 31% to $1.66 billion
stories.summary: Private equity investment in Indian real estate fell 31% to $1.66 billion in the first nine months of 2026, according to Knight Frank. Domestic institutions supplied 85% of the money, against 25% a year earlier, as foreign investors cut exposure sharply.

stories.title: Lodha sets Rs 24,000 crore sales target and watches the Gulf
stories.summary: Lodha Developers' pre-sales rose 7% to Rs 9,670 crore in the first half of FY27, and it targets Rs 24,000 crore for the year. The developer flagged the Middle East conflict and the possible impact of AI on housing demand as risks to watch.

stories.title: S Naren calls Mumbai the costliest market, Bengaluru the most attractive
stories.summary: Speaking at an ET event in Mumbai, ICICI Prudential AMC's S Naren said home loan rates are the same across India but rental yields are not. In Mumbai and Delhi, yields sit far below loan rates. Bengaluru is the only city he views positively right now.

stories.title: CBRE sees demand for up to 1.5 billion sq ft of private education space
stories.summary: India will need about 1 to 1.5 billion sq ft of additional private education infrastructure by FY2035, a CBRE South Asia report said. Private K-12 schools would account for nearly 0.9 billion sq ft and private higher education about 0.4 billion sq ft.

stories.title: Suraj Estate Developers' Q2 profit falls 30% to Rs 23 crore
stories.summary: Mumbai-based Suraj Estate Developers reported Q2 net profit of Rs 23.06 crore, down from Rs 33.09 crore a year earlier. Total income rose to Rs 171.08 crore from Rs 145.42 crore, while expenses climbed to Rs 140.12 crore from Rs 101.33 crore.

stories.title: Pharma firm Gufic buys Rs 236 crore duplex in Juhu
stories.summary: Gufic Private Limited bought a 19,694 sq ft duplex in Lodha Avalon on Juhu Tara Road for Rs 236.33 crore, registration documents accessed through Zapkey showed. It comes with 10 car parking spaces, at roughly Rs 1.2 lakh per sq ft. Parking, at least, is solved.

stories.title: DLF gets MahaRERA nod for second phase of The Westpark
stories.summary: DLF has received MahaRERA registration for the second phase of its Mumbai project The Westpark and is likely to launch it in November, sources told Hindustan Times. The first phase generated sales bookings of over Rs 2,300 crore.

stories.title: Marathon Nextgen to buy Adani's 60% stake in Byculla project
stories.summary: Marathon Nextgen Realty's board approved buying the Adani Group's 60% stake in Monte South, a Byculla project in Mumbai, for about Rs 335 crore, taking its holding to 100%. Marathon said Adani is exiting to focus on larger developments in the region.

stories.title: Buyers aged 25 to 45 drive 62% of Majiwade home registrations
stories.summary: Homebuyers aged 25 to 45 accounted for 62% of residential registrations in Thane's Majiwade in 2026, a CRE Matrix report said. Unsold inventory fell 18% to 4,644 units, and the overhang shrank from 17 quarters to 13 quarters.

stories.title: Andheri West prices rise 10 to 13%, premium rents touch Rs 1.25 lakh
stories.summary: Property prices in Andheri West have risen around 10% to 13% year on year, with premium rentals reaching Rs 1.25 lakh a month, Business Today reports. Connectivity, redevelopment projects and access to business districts are cited as drivers of demand.

stories.title: AGI Infra gets RERA approval for 661-unit Utopia in New Chandigarh
stories.summary: AGI Infra has secured RERA approval for Utopia By AGI in New Chandigarh, valid until 30 March 2031. The project spans 10.26 acres with about 31.94 lakh sq ft of saleable area across 661 units in 3BHK, 4BHK and 5BHK formats on 31 floors.

stories.title: Sanjay Manjrekar sells Alibaug land to CarTrade Tech for Rs 22.4 crore
stories.summary: Former India cricketer Sanjay Manjrekar sold an 8,050 sq m land parcel in Dhokawade village, Alibaug, to CarTrade Tech for Rs 22.40 crore, registration documents accessed by CRE Matrix show. Stamp duty was Rs 1.344 crore. The car marketplace now owns some land.

stories.title: Phoenix Mills Q2 profit rises 7% as office income jumps 64%
stories.summary: Phoenix Mills reported consolidated net profit of Rs 326 crore for the September quarter, up 7.14% year on year, on revenue of Rs 1,153 crore. Commercial office income rose 64% as occupancy improved across Mumbai and Pune assets. The mall company is increasingly an office company.

stories.title: Smartworks lifts FY27 growth guidance after 39% revenue jump
stories.summary: Smartworks Coworking Spaces posted Q2 FY27 net profit of Rs 25.64 crore as revenue from operations rose 39% to Rs 591 crore. It raised FY27 revenue growth guidance to 33% to 35% and runs about 17.5 million sq ft across 71 centres.

stories.title: 91Springboard adds five hubs and 8,000 seats
stories.summary: 91Springboard plans five new workspace hubs across Chennai, the Mumbai region and NCR, adding over 360,000 sq ft and 8,000 seats and taking its network to 49 hubs. A JLL report it cited says flex spaces took 27% of top-seven-city leasing in H1 2026.

stories.title: Landmark Group plans Rs 15,000 crore NCR push
stories.summary: Landmark Group has announced a Rs 15,000 crore NCR plan, a Rs 4,000 crore Grade A+ office on Golf Course Extension Road and a proposed Rs 11,000 crore integrated luxury destination on Dwarka Expressway. It is also preparing to enter branded residences.

stories.title: Mukund MGM Realty buys former Infosys campus in Mangaluru
stories.summary: Mukund MGM Realty has acquired the 2.75-acre property in Mangaluru's Kottara area that formerly housed an Infosys campus, with the transfer completed on 23 October. The price was not disclosed. Plans for the site will be announced later, the company said.

stories.title: Trent's store rollout is reshaping urban retail space
stories.summary: Urban Acres argues Trent's results show organised retail growing through physical stores, with Zudio and Westside expanding into peripheral markets and Tier 2 cities. Trent's consolidated Q2 net profit rose 25% to Rs 468 crore on revenue of Rs 5,873 crore.

stories.title: Stylework reports Rs 50.2 crore FY26 revenue and stays profitable
stories.summary: Flexible office platform Stylework reported FY26 revenue of Rs 50.20 crore and profit after tax of Rs 2 crore, its second profitable year. Its EBITDA margin rose from 4% to 8% and annualised GMV crossed Rs 350 crore, the company said.

stories.title: Hyatt signs four North India hotels with Saraca
stories.summary: Hyatt has signed agreements with Saraca Hotels and Resorts for four hotels across Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand. Two existing Saraca properties in Lucknow and Corbett will introduce the Unscripted by Hyatt brand to India, and two more are planned near Jim Corbett National Park.

stories.title: L&T starts building a 52MW data centre in Chennai
stories.summary: Larsen and Toubro has begun construction of a 52MW data centre in Chennai, developed by Vyoma.AI, its AI cloud and hyperscale data centre business. The facility will form part of L&T's planned AI Factory campus in the city. The groundbreaking was marked with a Bhoomi Pujan.

stories.title: Data centre tax holiday draws interest, but the rules are missing
stories.summary: The data centre tax holiday is drawing interest from foreign cloud and hyperscale players, industry executives told BusinessLine. Operational rules for the holiday have not been issued yet, and regulatory and cost hurdles could slow investment. The holiday exists. The paperwork does not.

stories.title: AI data centres meet local resistance in India
stories.summary: ET reports AI data centre growth is causing tension with communities over land, environment and resources. Villagers near Visakhapatnam allege land was taken for Google's AI hub without adequate consultation, and residents near Amazon's proposed 53-acre Thane site cite electricity, water and noise.

stories.title: Power Grid asks cable makers to scale up for data centre demand
stories.summary: Power Grid chairman Vamsi Rama Mohan Burra urged domestic cable and wire makers to expand capacity, saying this year's capex should be much higher than last year's roughly Rs 40,000 crore. Data centres, renewables and urbanisation are pushing electricity demand up.

stories.title: US industrial leasing jumps 38.5% in Q3, JLL says
stories.summary: US industrial leasing reached nearly 203 million sq ft in Q3, up 38.5% from a year ago, JLL said, with data centre demand a driver. Net absorption rose nearly 87% to 71.4 million sq ft, and the construction pipeline grew to 317 million sq ft.

stories.title: Terreno buys Silicon Valley industrial property for $29 million
stories.summary: Industrial REIT Terreno Realty acquired a five-building, 80,000 sq ft industrial flex property on a 4.1-acre site in San Carlos, California, for about $29 million. The deal closed on 29 October and sits next to US Highway 101.

stories.title: Adler secures $213 million for light industrial portfolio
stories.summary: Miami-based Adler Real Estate Partners secured $212.79 million in financing for a 1.57 million sq ft light industrial portfolio of eight properties and 43 buildings across five US states. More than 115 tenants across 22 industries occupy the parks.

stories.title: Prologis outlook puts power at the centre of logistics demand
stories.summary: Prologis released its 2027 Global Supply Chain Outlook, covering energy use, AI adoption and geopolitical disruption. It says power availability for warehouses is shaping logistics demand, and customers want buildings that can support AI workloads alongside distribution. Warehouses now ask about megawatts first.

stories.title: MSRDC to map 1,800 sq km along Samruddhi Mahamarg
stories.summary: The Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation plans GIS-based land-use mapping and development planning across about 1,800 sq km and 292 villages in 10 districts along the Samruddhi Mahamarg. As the special planning authority, it will prepare statutory development plans for the corridor.

stories.title: Centre clears north corridor of bullet train project
stories.summary: Railway minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said the Prime Minister has cleared the north corridor of the bullet train project, linking Delhi with Agra, Kanpur, Lucknow, Varanasi, Patna and Siliguri before extending to Guwahati. Delhi to Kanpur would take 1 hour 45 minutes.

stories.title: UP plans a Singapore City near Noida International Airport
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh plans a dedicated Singapore City in Sector 7 near Noida International Airport at Jewar, Yeida said. Officials said the urban area for high-end customers would draw Singapore investment, after the state met a Singapore Business Federation delegation in Lucknow.

stories.title: Kerala hands Vizhinjam growth corridor to ports department
stories.summary: Kerala has moved the outer area growth corridor project linked to Vizhinjam port from the local self-government department to the ports department to cut delays. The state expects the Centre to approve the Thiruvananthapuram outer ring road within a month.

stories.title: Emirates and Air France-KLM resist moving to Navi Mumbai Airport
stories.summary: Mumbai airport operator MIAL wants to shift about five million passengers a year by March 2027 for Terminal 1B work. Indian airlines have complied, but Emirates and Air France-KLM have cited concerns about Navi Mumbai airport's infrastructure, Mint reports.

stories.title: Karnataka discusses Bengaluru to Mangaluru high-speed corridor
stories.summary: Karnataka minister Dinesh Gundu Rao held talks with the European Business and Technology Centre on a proposed six to eight lane greenfield high-speed corridor between Bengaluru and Mangaluru. He said the route map needs more discussion and he would raise it with the chief minister.

stories.title: Jammu to get an underground communication corridor
stories.summary: Jammu will get an underground communication corridor between Purani Mandi Chowk and Bharat Mata Chowk under a central capital investment scheme. It aims to remove overhead cables and limit repeated road digging along a busy high street developed by Jammu Smart City.

stories.title: Lucknow plans One City, One Card
stories.summary: Lucknow plans a One City, One Card smart card under the Smart City Mission to pay water tax, electricity bills, parking, e-challans, Metro fares and bus tickets. It will link with the Lucknow Smart app. One card, many queues avoided, in theory.

stories.title: Agra Smart City starts heritage walkway near the Taj
stories.summary: Agra Smart City Limited has begun work on a Rs 3.08 crore heritage walk around the Taj Mahal, including a 1.65 km walkway in Tajganj, after ASI approval. A 400-metre stretch still needs forest department clearance, which officials hope to get in January.

stories.title: IBBI tightens real estate insolvency rules to prioritise home delivery
stories.summary: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India notified amendments mandating independent construction assessments and delivery schedules in real estate insolvencies. Creditors with at least 66% of votes can recommend excluding projects, and homebuyers get representation on monitoring committees.

stories.title: Naredco and Credai seek calibrated CAQM construction curbs
stories.summary: Naredco and Credai asked that NCR construction restrictions be linked to actual pollution levels rather than a blanket ban, after the CAQM ordered curbs on dust-generating demolition and outdoor construction from 5 to 20 November, with exemptions for essential public infrastructure.

stories.title: BDA amends Ekamra Residency rules to align with RERA
stories.summary: The Bhubaneswar Development Authority cut the earnest money refund timeline for unsuccessful applicants from 60 days to 45 days and replaced a flat 12% interest on delayed instalments with SBI's highest MCLR plus 2%. The project had seen a poor response.

stories.title: NCLT voids JLS Realty land transfer and Rs 525 crore IIFL deal
stories.summary: The NCLT Mumbai bench invalidated JLS Realty's transfer of a Mumbai redevelopment parcel to Spenta Suncity and a mortgage and guarantee tied to Rs 525 crore of IIFL financing. It also ordered restoration of the company's land after five years of litigation.

stories.title: Possession delayed? Lawyers outline homebuyer options
stories.summary: At an ET event in Mumbai, real estate lawyers said Section 18 of RERA lets buyers exit with a refund plus interest or stay and claim interest until handover. They said RERA orders are hard to enforce, consumer forums act faster, and a registered sale agreement protects buyers best.

stories.title: LIC Housing Finance Q2 profit grows 12% as bad loans ease
stories.summary: LIC Housing Finance's Q2 net profit grew 12% year on year. Gross NPAs fell to 2.05% from 2.51% and net NPAs to 1.06%. It also identified Rs 19,610 crore of loans for reclassification from housing to non-housing, saying total loan assets are not materially affected.

stories.title: PNB Housing targets Rs 11,000 crore corporate loan book
stories.summary: PNB Housing Finance MD and CEO Ajai Kumar Shukla told Financial Express the lender targets an Rs 11,000 crore corporate loan book in three years, focused on 8 to 10 major cities. Disbursements grew 60% in Q2 and the corporate book grew 107%.

stories.title: Hinduja Housing Finance names Vivek Kannan CEO
stories.summary: Hinduja Housing Finance appointed Vivek Kannan as CEO, succeeding Sachin Pillai, who stepped down as managing director and stays on the board. Kannan joined as COO in 2020 and has worked at Motilal Oswal, DHFL, Citibank, Barclays and GE Capital.

stories.title: Link REIT sells Hong Kong tower at 61% below its 2016 price
stories.summary: Link REIT agreed to sell 700 Nathan Road in Mong Kok for HK$2.3 billion, having paid HK$5.91 billion in a 2016 government tender. It is Link's third disposal this year. The company says it is divesting non-core assets to simplify its business.

stories.title: San Jose BioSquare campus seized in $50 million foreclosure
stories.summary: South Bay Development Co. took control of BioSquare Silicon Valley through foreclosure, paying $50 million, county filings show. That is 65% below the $144.5 million a PCCP-led group paid in 2018. The campus was touted as a hub for up-and-coming companies.

stories.title: Truist lends $152 million to turn Long Beach offices into homes
stories.summary: Truist provided a $152 million construction loan to Carmel Partners for Marina Shores, a 390-unit mixed-income project replacing two older office buildings in Long Beach. Seventeen units are reserved for very low-income households, and completion is slated for May 2029.

stories.title: Attollo Capital and Blackstone eye Gulf distressed real estate
stories.summary: Attollo Capital announced a working relationship with Blackstone to pursue distressed real estate and direct investment opportunities in the Middle East, with the UAE and Oman as primary focus markets. The announcement came from Attollo. Distressed, in the Gulf, is now a pitch.

stories.title: Info Edge CEO Hitesh Oberoi to step down as 99acres turns cash positive
stories.summary: Info Edge's standalone Q2 profit rose 36% to Rs 333.9 crore, and Hitesh Oberoi steps down as MD and CEO on 2 December, with Sanjeev Bikhchandani becoming Group CEO. 99acres billings grew 21.2% and its operating losses narrowed 93%.

stories.title: MLS executives weigh the new Open Real Estate initiative
stories.summary: US brokerages AGNT, HomeServices of America, Keller Williams and Real REMAX Group launched Open Real Estate, a listing data-sharing initiative requiring submission within one business day of a listing agreement. Its founders say it is not a national MLS. MLS executives are weighing that.

stories.title: NAR's REACH accelerator wins an Inman proptech award
stories.summary: The National Association of Realtors' Second Century Ventures and its REACH accelerator won a 2026 Inman Best of Proptech Award for venture capital and proptech investment. REACH companies MaxHome.ai and Back at You were also recognised. The realtors are now also the investors.

stories.title: Tracey Fellows to leave REA Group after 12 years
stories.summary: Former REA Group CEO Tracey Fellows will leave the company in November after 12 years, first as CEO and then as a non-executive director. Realtor.com CEO Damian Eales is set to take her board seat, chairman Hamish McLennan said.

stories.title: Where AI actually works in real estate development
stories.summary: Tech Insider maps where AI earns its cost in property development, arguing development is a chain of decisions made with incomplete data. Document extraction from leases, title records and loan agreements is the most reliable use today. The data is worse than anyone expects, it notes.

stories.title: Romanian lawyers on tokenised property and embedded finance
stories.summary: Lawyers at Filip and Company write that tokenisation is fractionating property ownership onto distributed ledgers, while listing platforms now process payments, assess tenants and facilitate lending. The challenge, they argue, is making legal and regulatory rules keep pace. The apartment ad now wants a banking licence.

stories.title: Signature Global awards Rs 496 crore contract for Lamborghini-branded towers
stories.summary: Signature Global awarded B.L. Kashyap and Sons a construction contract worth about Rs 496 crore for Tonino Lamborghini Residences on Southern Peripheral Road, Gurugram. The 12.40-acre project has 812 residences, with four towers of 41 floors each.

stories.title: HeidelbergCement India's Q2 profit falls 33% to Rs 16.77 crore
stories.summary: HeidelbergCement India's September-quarter net profit fell 32.7% to Rs 16.77 crore from Rs 24.93 crore. Revenue rose 10.96% on higher volumes and better pricing, but total expenses rose 13.27%. Shares fell on the BSE after the results.

stories.title: Waste glass concrete blocks pass a 15-year test in Hong Kong
stories.summary: Researchers studied Hong Kong paving blocks installed 15 years ago with recycled waste glass replacing part of the aggregate. Field checks found the blocks stable and no internal cracking linked to alkali-silica reaction. Lab tests could not answer that. Fifteen years of weather could.

stories.title: Swedish road slag study finds metals leach early, then settle
stories.summary: A road near Lulea built on copper-smelting slag in 1997 was studied for a decade. All materials, including the crushed rock control, showed high concentrations against Swedish guidelines. A 2023 review found leaching usually reaches equilibrium after 9 to 10 years.

stories.title: Newcastle researchers grow a fungi dome in knitted moulds
stories.summary: Researchers at Newcastle University grew a mycelium-based material called MycoCrete inside knitted moulds to build a freestanding dome. It was stronger and shrank less than earlier mycelium experiments, though it is not yet a replacement for conventional concrete.

stories.title: Bitumen shortage slows Sri Lanka's road projects
stories.summary: A bitumen shortage linked to Middle East shipping disruptions is delaying road projects in Sri Lanka, the Central Bank said. The construction PMI was 57.8 in September, down from 59.4 in August, still above the 50 mark that signals expansion.

stories.title: Vulcan Materials absorbs energy costs as Q3 EBITDA hits $707 million
stories.summary: Vulcan Materials reported Q3 adjusted EBITDA of $707 million, with margin up 20 basis points to 32.3%, as higher prices offset energy costs. It now expects full-year energy headwinds above $100 million, including diesel and liquid asphalt.

stories.title: Builders FirstSource beats estimates as sales fall 2.2%
stories.summary: Builders FirstSource reported Q3 revenue of $3.85 billion, down 2.2% year on year but above estimates, and adjusted EPS of $1.51 against forecasts of $1.04. StockStory credits cost controls in a weak housing market. Beating estimates while shrinking is a skill.

stories.title: Meta backs Fortera's low-carbon cement
stories.summary: Meta has signed a deal with Fortera that gives it the equivalent of 200,000 tons of environmental attribute credits, along with access to low-carbon cement for building its projects, ESG Dive reports.

stories.title: India faces 600 kilotons of solar waste by 2030
stories.summary: India could generate 600 kilotons of solar waste by 2030, with around 67% from five states, Financial Express reports, citing a 2024 study. The country has about 170 GW of installed solar capacity, and panels last up to about 35 years.

stories.title: Are climate risks starting to change property values?
stories.summary: Realty Today argues flood, water stress and heat are becoming financial risks in Indian real estate valuation. It cites a 2016 study finding flood risk in Mumbai cut mean residential sales prices by 12.6% to 15% in its sample.

stories.title: USGBC launches TRUE v2 zero waste certification
stories.summary: The US Green Building Council launched TRUE v2, an updated zero waste certification focused on global applicability. TRUE has certified more than 680 projects totalling 272 million sq ft, diverting 8.9 million tons of waste from landfill, USGBC says.

stories.title: B.C. building electrification projects honoured
stories.summary: The Building to Electrification Coalition gave six awards in British Columbia, recognising projects from all-electric duplex homes and hospitals to energy-saving shopping centres and credit unions. The awards were handed out to about 200 leaders from design, construction and policy.

stories.title: Norwich needs 2,766 homes a year to quit gas
stories.summary: Norwich City Council says 62,169 homes must be electrified for the city to reach net zero by 2045, an average of 2,766 a year. The council does not propose forcing homeowners to replace boilers and admits it has limited powers. The boilers have been notified.

stories.title: San Diego affordable housing project goes mass timber
stories.summary: Father Joe's Villages has broken ground on a $47 million, 124-unit affordable housing project in San Diego's East Village using mass timber. The developer said it could cut build time from 20 to 22 months to 15 to 16 months.

stories.title: Most homes in prime London now sell below asking
stories.summary: Eight in 10 properties in London's priciest neighbourhoods now sell below asking price, Coutts found, at an average 10% discount. Prime central London prices fell 5% in Q3 and are 14% below their 2014 peak. Asking price has become an opening remark.

stories.title: Ireland's housing crisis may be turning a corner
stories.summary: New home completions in Ireland rose 10.4% in July to September, with almost 27,000 finished so far in 2026, RTE reports. Analysts expect 39,000 to 40,000 this year, still short of the 50,000 to 60,000 needed to meet demand.

stories.title: Seoul office rents rise for 19th straight quarter
stories.summary: Seoul's office rental price index rose 0.30% in Q3, its 19th consecutive quarterly rise, the Korea Real Estate Agency said, on demand for large offices in Yeouido and Gangnam. Shopping mall rents trended down as weak consumption hit retail.

stories.title: EIB adds a €300 million housing loan for Portugal
stories.summary: The European Investment Bank will lend a further €300 million for housing construction and renovation in Portugal, taking its housing commitments there to about €3 billion over two years. Most of the money will support private-sector projects.

stories.title: Hong Kong shuns death-linked flats while France bets on longevity
stories.summary: Hong Kong buyers often avoid homes linked to an unnatural death, with prices falling up to 50% and rents about 20% lower, agents told SCMP. In France, viager sales let buyers purchase at discounts of up to 80%, betting on the seller's lifespan.

stories.title: Nigeria begins 2,000 affordable homes in Lagos
stories.summary: Nigeria's government has begun building 2,000 housing units in Ibeju-Lekki, Lagos, under a public-private partnership, and unveiled mortgage reforms. Housing minister Muttaqha Rabe Darma listed supply, mortgage access, private partnerships and evidence-based policy as priorities.

stories.title: Simon Property to buy Seattle's University Village
stories.summary: Simon Property Group agreed to acquire University Village, a nearly 600,000 sq ft open-air shopping centre in Seattle with more than 100 retailers and restaurants. The deal is expected to close in Q4 2026. The price was not disclosed.

stories.title: Canadian housing won't be affordable for decades, Globe argues
stories.summary: A Globe and Mail opinion says Canadian home values fell about 15% from 2021 to 2025 in real terms but still need a mortgage of roughly $544,000. With the housing strategy up for renewal in 2027, it urges help for young Canadians meanwhile.
